description: A bakery uses a stand-mixer and a slow bake oven to make bread and cookies. Each machine can run for at most 3000 hours per year. To bake a loaf of bread takes 1 hour in the stand mixer and 3 hours in the oven. A batch of cookies requires 0.5 hours in the mixer and 1 hour in the oven. The profit per loaf of bread is $5 and the profit per batch of cookies is $3. How should the bakery operate to maximize total profit?

MixerMaximumHours.definition: Maximum available operating hours per year for the stand mixer

OvenMaximumHours.definition: Maximum available operating hours per year for the oven

BreadMixerTime.definition: Number of hours the stand mixer is required to bake one loaf of bread

BreadOvenTime.definition: Number of hours the oven is required to bake one loaf of bread

CookiesMixerTime.definition: Number of hours the stand mixer is required to bake one batch of cookies

CookiesOvenTime.definition: Number of hours the oven is required to bake one batch of cookies

BreadProfit.definition: Profit earned per loaf of bread

CookiesProfit.definition: Profit earned per batch of cookies

objective.description: "Maximize the total profit from producing loaves of bread and batches of cookies"

constraints.description: 3 * (number of loaves of bread) + 1 * (number of batches of cookies) must be less than or equal to OvenMaximumHours
The number of loaves of bread produced must be greater than or equal to 0
The number of batches of cookies produced must be greater than or equal to 0

BreadQuantity.definition: Number of loaves of bread produced per year

CookiesQuantity.definition: Number of batches of cookies produced per year
